name: MATH_OBFUSCATION_OF_INEQUALITY
description: Replaces the explicit enumeration of valid distinct pairs with a mathematical property (product is not a perfect square) that is logically equivalent on the domain {1,2,3}. This prevents models from instantly recognizing the problem as Graph 3-Coloring and applying graph-specific heuristics like degree-ordering, causing naive backtracking to fail on hard instances.
